title: Olive and the Trail of Clues
note: b415 — Phase 5 (School readiness) — new sounds 'wh' and 'ph'.

pages.brief: Olive the owl tilting her head at something small on the garden path.
A small twig lying in a shallow puddle on the path.
Olive the owl noticing a small shell lying beside the twig.
Olive the owl studying the twig and the shell side by side.
A small nut resting on a wide leaf further along the path.
Olive the owl gathering the twig, the shell and the nut into one claw.
Olive the owl walking steadily along the path, following the trail.
Olive the owl spotting Pip the sparrow waiting at the end of the path.
Pip the sparrow looking at the ground near his nest, as if he had been searching for something.
Olive the owl setting the twig, shell and nut down in front of Pip; Pip the sparrow and Olive the owl grinning together.
